exposure: High Frequency Oscillatory Ventilation with Volume Guarantee (HFOV-VG)
outcome: Stability of High Frequency tidal volume (VThf)
Correlations between VThf and Diffusion Coefficient of Carbon Dioxide (DCO2)
Correlations between VThf and key respiratory markers (measured amplitude, FiO2, frequency, MAP, PCO2)
cohort: The study included 22 extremely preterm infants treated with HFOV-VG as the primary mode of ventilation at King Abdulaziz Medical City.
finding: HFOV-VG effectively stabilized VThf in extremely preterm infants, and weight-corrected DCO2 correlated strongly with VThf and measured amplitude, suggesting its potential as a reliable marker for CO2 clearance.
